messages.subject: problem compiling INLA
parts:
Hi everyone.
I am trying to compile INLA on a ubuntu (precise pangolin) server.
After
make download
I launched
make bin.
The compilation stops with this error:
src/eval.c: In function ‘inla_eval_expression’:
src/eval.c:173:23: error: ‘muBASETYPE_FLOAT’ undeclared (first use in this function)
src/eval.c:173:23: note: each undeclared identifier is reported only once for each function it appears in
make[2]: *** [src/eval.o] Error 1


Now eval.c includes:
#include <muParser/muParserDLL.h>

which, on my server is located in: /usr/include/muParser/muParserDLL.h


what I am missing?
Any help is appreciated.

Fabio
